bio: Cal Marquès is located in the historic centre of Camprodon, one of the prettiest towns in the Ripollès area. Here, within the stone walls of an imposing building that was once owned by the Marquis of Alfarràs, choose from a traditional Catalan-inspired à la carte with its roots in the surrounding area and a desire explore the flavours of its ingredients, an “executive” menu (Petit Àpat), plus a tasting-style option (Simbiosi). Dishes featuring Ripollès lamb reared on the family farm are the undoubted stars of the show....
